question: At the time of interest rate reset, must the lender offer EMI-based personal loan borrowers the option to switch to a fixed rate?
query: q022 (eval/gold.jsonl), replayed from eval/cassettes after the backend final pass, 24-Nov-2026

rows.text: Yes: at the time of reset of interest rates, REs shall provide EMI based floating rate personal loan borrowers the option to switch over to a fixed rate as per their Board approved policy.

rows.text: The bank’s own policy says the Bank may, at its option, offer the borrower a choice to switch to a fixed rate at the time of reset of the floating rate, which is narrower than the in-force RBI requirement.

citations.title: Example UCB Retail Loan Policy v3 (FICTIONAL)
citations.text: 6.3 At the time of reset of the floating rate, the Bank may, at its option, offer the borrower a choice to switch to a fixed rate as per its Board approved policy.
